resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1949 survey text says state forest service; the Central U.S. page header and our record say Texas Forest Service. Treated as the same agency.

notes_for_editor: Height matches the record: NGS text says about 110 feet, which is about 33.5 m. Agency and gone status agree across the FFLA list and the Central U.S. page. The only dated observation is the 1949 survey description; the removal date is not in any source read, so no removal event is recorded. No build date, staffing, fire history, access rule or present-day condition was found. Wikipedia is used for town context only.
